description:
Preview the complete linked Interslavic reader / download the PDF.

This is the complete maintained Interslavic edition of the Emmy Noether corpus in release v047: Papers 1–43, Work 44, Paper 45, and the bibliography. The Latin reader is the default preview; the deterministic Cyrillic reader is included in the evidence archive, and editable sources for both scripts are included together. It is a machine-assisted scholarly working edition, not a peer-reviewed critical edition and not a claim of native-speaker certification. Exact source, build, QA, render, provenance, unresolved-item, and hash evidence accompany the release.

Stable Interslavic concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21926382; exact release DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21926383.

DataCite intent: this edition IsTranslationOf the German authority corpus NOETH-DE-ED-0011 (SHA-256 9E6BF2BC3155ECE3DF98CD8A408C23662BEFB047A1DDF200CA1DC8476A488BF3) and IsPartOf the multilingual hub 10.5281/zenodo.20412587. Current Zenodo relation vocabulary carries IsPartOf; the intended IsTranslationOf mapping is preserved in the evidence sidecar.
